title: Orquestra de Bolso (orchestral bossa after Jobim)
comment: No drum kit: the groove is pizzicato basses (bossa thumb pattern), harp as the guitar's syncopated finger chords, violas pizz on upbeats, and clarinets anticipating each chord by an eighth. Form: intro / A (flute) / B up a minor third (horns) / A' (violins, full) / tag over Gm9 to Gb7#11, looping back to F.
